# Scenario: Docker named volumes are allowed and the stack starts.
# README Strict Volume & Socket Control (positive path).
# Written compose uses compose-go long form (type/source/target), not short data:/data.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: named volume fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-volnamed-web
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-volnamed/docker-compose.yml
grep 'type: volume' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-volnamed/docker-compose.yml
grep 'source: data' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-volnamed/docker-compose.yml
grep 'target: /data' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-volnamed/docker-compose.yml
! exists $HOME/.events

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-volnamed
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9981
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-volnamed/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    volumes:
      - data:/data
volumes:
  data:

-- .env --
